## Engineering unit

Describe the scoped change and its exact product-source baseline.

## Verification

- [ ] Actual commands and results are listed.
- [ ] Skipped, unavailable and blocked checks are identified honestly.
- [ ] Source policy and no-em-dash checks pass.
- [ ] No secret, private key or signer material is committed.
- [ ] Documentation and the five project logs are updated when this is a checkpoint.

## Documentation impact

List the README and supporting documents updated for interface, API, runtime, deployment, test, security, provider or judge-facing changes.

If no documentation change is required, include one specific line in this exact form:

`Documentation impact: none - <specific reason>`

## Contract and financial impact

- [ ] No contract or financial invariant changes.
- [ ] Contract CI is required and passes.
- [ ] Sandbox integration is required and passes, or its infrastructure blocker is documented.
- [ ] Full F01 through F18 P0 is required and passes with evidence artifacts.

Explain every selected or unselected item that is relevant. Never weaken an assertion to make a check pass.

## External actions

- [ ] No testnet or mainnet signing or deployment occurred.
- [ ] No paid inference occurred.
- [ ] No production secret or repository secret changed.
- [ ] No automatic merge is enabled.

## Merge recommendation

State the required checks, unresolved blockers and whether owner authorisation is still required.
